card.name: Small words in male-patient statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, with, including, those) right after males, men or boys in label text about male patients, fertility or testosterone products. It also fires on a few words in testosterone-injection warnings.

card.writes: It pushes the model away from male-related words and toward beauty, jewelry, dance and other feminine-leaning topics.
card.plain: It marks spots in male-patient sentences where the text is already about men, so the model avoids repeating male words.
